Identifier for the credential store to use for this entitlement
context. This is a synonym for the CredentialStore parameter.
The module accepts this synonym to make it easier to verify that
the Entitlement context and the Authentication context use
the same values.
There is no default for this parameter. Either the ResourceURI or
CredentialStore must be provided. If both are provided, the
module uses the value of the CredentialStore.
